subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The CrowdStrike Global Outage
description: A fast breakdown of The CrowdStrike Global Outage for builders.

hook.text: On July 19, 2024, a CrowdStrike update crashed 8.5 million Windows computers worldwide in hours.

buildup.text: The faulty update caused blue screens of death across airlines, hospitals, banks, and emergency services.

discovery.text: Delta Airlines alone lost over $500 million. Global economic damage exceeded $10 billion.

twist.text: The update wasn't a cyberattack. It was a routine security patch that wasn't properly tested.

climax.text: One vendor update broke the world's infrastructure. Single points of failure exist everywhere.

punchline.text: One update. 8.5 million crashes. Not a hack. A patch.

quiz.question: What caused the 2024 CrowdStrike global outage?
options: A faulty routine security update that wasn't properly tested
A power outage at CrowdStrike's data center
